{{Short description|British World War II administrator at Bletchley Park}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}
'''Ione Roseveare''' (née Katherine Ione Jay) (9 November 1920, [[Weobley]] – 24 September 2010, [[Uppingham]]) was a Temporary Junior Administrative Officer at [[Hut 6]], [[Bletchley Park]].<ref name="BPT">{{cite web|title=Bletchley Park Roll of Honour|url=https://bletchleypark.org.uk/roll-of-honour/4854|website=Bletchley Park|publisher=Bletchley Park Trust|accessdate=10 October 2017}}</ref> She met her husband [[Bob Roseveare]] while working there.

Ione was studying for [[Licentiate (degree)|licentiate]] of the [[Royal Academy of Music]] in [[Bristol]] in 1941. However she was evacuated to [[Wells, Somerset]]. Here she was interviewed by [[Gordon Welchman]], who was recruiting for Bletchley Park.<ref name="SM">{{cite web|title=How Iona helped the Bletchley Park code-breakers|url=http://www.stamfordmercury.co.uk/news/how-iona-helped-the-bletchley-park-code-breakers-1-482589|website=www.stamfordmercury.co.uk|publisher=Stamford Mercury|accessdate=10 October 2017|language=en}}</ref>

In 2005 she contributed a chapter "Memories of Bletchley Park 1941-5" to a local history volume in Uppingham, Rutland, UK.<ref name="book">{{cite book| title=Uppingham in Living Memory : Snapshots of Uppingham in the 20th Century, part 1 | publisher=Uppingham Local History Study Group |author=<!--Not stated--> | year=2007 | isbn=9780954007645 | pages=53–56 | url= http://www.uppinghamhistory.org.uk/pubs/atwar.pdf}}</ref>
